parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden cabinet door that covers the front opening of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other parts of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The bottom panel of the cabinet that supports the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable base for the cabinet and supports internal loads.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden cabinet door identical to the first one.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the other side of the cabinet’s storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Triangle Connection (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small triangular metal connector used to reinforce cabinet corners.
parts.Functional_description: It strengthens the joint between panels and maintains cabinet rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
